requirements: 骨架层：L4 单一接入 + L2 请求范围
身份从已有host/runtime principal派生；模型不能自报user/system完成归因。
首次持久化operationId；同逻辑动作重试复用key，同参数新意图允许新key；同key异payload拒绝。
基于已有持久日志补workspace级串行提交与expectedRevision或等效CAS；批次内多个合法事件共享batch key不被误删。

acceptance.text: 自动create/link/update经受控路径记录agent身份；现有手工编辑保留其真实身份和语义。
两个陈旧revision写入恰一个成功；并发重复operation、追加后崩溃、projection损坏均可恢复且无重复逻辑效果。
Host API/facade/service合同一致；不新增扁平IPC/renderer直连，不新建任务数据库。
负例：伪造actor；同key异参；合法同参数新操作被误去重；批次部分提交后重放
证据包含driven_by:agent、真实actor、source/candidate/输入配置版本、命令/exit/count、artifact hash、负例与未测范围；不以stdout或模型自述收口。

limits: A2 records trusted facts and safe logical retries; it is not independent task completion acceptance or tool authorization.
TF-0664 remains incomplete; A3 and later leaves are not covered.
Agent-driven scripted local-provider flow is not real-human or model-quality evidence.
Controlled process exits, lock publication interruption and PID-reuse fixtures are not power-loss, network-filesystem or long-term reliability proof.
Existing installed dependencies were reused; fresh install, packaged release, non-Windows native execution and globally green CI are not claimed.
See repository-residuals.json and prior-failures.json for explicit failures that this acceptance does not erase.
